$comment: Reviewed allowlist for the branding gate (scripts/check-branding.ts, VOR-3). Each entry exempts a path prefix (repo-relative), optionally narrowed to specific rule ids. Classes: wire-contract (must never change — roadmap/upstream/compatibility.md), upstream-internal (upstream-owned files/demo data). NOTE: the flip-sync and flip-deferred classes were RESOLVED by PLAN-019 (Vorno rebrand, ADR-0009) — those static files (electron-builder.yml, package.json metadata, HTML shells, PWA manifest, i18n locale values, afterPack hook, session-tools-core tool descriptions) now say 'Vorno' and are back under the gate, so reintroducing a 'Craft Agents' string there FAILS CI. Adding an entry requires PR review — do not exempt new product code; import from @craft-agent/shared/branding instead.

entries.reason: Design-system playground shell — internal dev surface, not shipped UX.
Design-system playground demo/sample data (fake chats, sample links) — internal dev surface.

Static bundled assets (config-defaults.json, the built bridge-mcp-server bundle, theme/tool-icon metadata, smoke-test fixtures) plus bundled docs/release-notes (.md, which the gate does not scan). Regenerated/reviewed on upstream sync and not part of the Vorno UX flip; the built bundle in particular must not be hand-edited. Deliberately kept out of PLAN-019's sweep.
Dev-server proxy target to the production session API — dev-only tooling, not shipped.
Maps the external Craft (docs product) source to its own domain craft.do — a third-party integration reference, not our brand endpoint.
LLM validator prompt for the external Craft (docs product) MCP server — mcp.craft.do is that product's own domain and part of functional validation rules, not our brand endpoint.
Developer debug script (bun run print:system-prompt) — annotation labels printed to a developer terminal, not shipped UX.
Lint-rule message shown to developers at lint time — not shipped UX.

The CRAFT_APP_NAME *value* is a filesystem path component: apps/electron/src/main/index.ts sets userData to appData/$CRAFT_APP_NAME for multi-instance dev. Renaming it silently orphans every existing dev profile, so this is a stored-path contract, not a display string.

Upstream standalone-server build script (present in upstream v0.12.0). Strings are developer terminal output plus the generated systemd unit Description; the deployment unit is Vorno-owned and rebranded separately by PLAN-013/023, not by the branding flip.
Upstream server installer (present in upstream v0.12.0); a POSIX shell script that cannot import the TS branding module. Developer terminal output only — not shipped UX.
Upstream dev helper (present in upstream v0.12.0) — the string is its --help banner printed to a developer terminal, not shipped UX.

Pristine upstream AppImage builder, byte-identical to upstream v0.12.0. Vorno ships macOS arm64 only (ADR-0009), so this never runs for us; keeping it unmodified avoids a permanent merge conflict on every upstream sync.
Pristine upstream Windows builder, byte-identical to upstream v0.12.0. Vorno ships macOS arm64 only (ADR-0009); kept unmodified to avoid a permanent merge conflict on every upstream sync.
